inventory_policy: Retain immutable header inventory; create a separate effective inventory using observed decode counts
bvp_alignment: Interpolate full raw BVP to the effective decoded count before selecting the common interval
cache_gate: All 101 recordings must decode to their effective counts before evaluation; no silent exclusion
source_matching: Relative path, header count, nominal fs, source size, selected bytes and raw BVP values; root and mtime ignored
fingerprint_scope: Selected container bytes are not a full video hash
